name: C2 Log Tailers
description: Bundled pack (SPEC-AI-ERA-PLUGINS Gap 2): follow a C2 framework log (Sliver, or any framework via the generic JSONL contract) and land beacon check-ins, task results and pivots on the RedLog timeline. Runs shell-side (out-of-process) and POSTs to the local API — no code runs inside RedLog.
author: RedLog

capture.name: Sliver → c2_checkin
capture.description: Follow a Sliver session/beacon JSON log; each object becomes a scanner.c2_checkin event.

manualSteps.label: Point the tailer at your Sliver JSON log (adjust the path)

capture.name: Generic C2 → timeline
capture.description: Follow any C2 log emitted in the RedLog-C2 JSONL contract ({kind:'checkin'|'task'|'pivot', ...}); see README.

manualSteps.label: Have your framework append RedLog-C2 JSONL to a file, then follow it
